name: Pipeliners - Workflow Skills
body:
> Guide · Pipeliners · 2026-10-13

# Summary
The Pipeliners project has its own Claude Code skills and one research agent prompt. This note summarizes all of them. Sources:
- `.claude\skills\rebuild-local-page\SKILL.md`
- `.claude\skills\restructure-local-page\SKILL.md`
- `docs\superpowers\specs\2026-10-07-rebuild-page-skill-design.md` (the design spec that led to the skills)
- `Pipeliners Workflow Skills.md` and `Pipeliners Agents\Keyword Researc and Cannibalization Check.md` (identical files: the keyword research skill)
- `.claude\settings.local.json` holds local permissions only and was not summarized.

# /rebuild-local-page <city> (full rebuild with new copy)
Rebuild one city page the way /avondale/ (post 13768) was rebuilt on 2026-10-10. One city per session; Kim approves twice (copy, then draft).
1. Check the page is allowed (not the homepage, /services-areas/, a sign/offer page, a held page, or edited by another session today). Ad check is skipped for this workflow (Kim, Oct 10).
2. Keyword research: GSC Domain property, 90 days, grouped by position; Search Atlas for city variants and parent terms; cannibalization check; save to `<city>-keyword-research-<date>\`.
3. Write simple homeowner copy in the Avondale section plan (hero, 4 benefit cards, question H2 with 40-60 word answer, CIPP process, local section with a verified local fact, problems, ePIPE, CTA, 8-10 FAQs). Copy rules: no em dashes, no banned words, no 24/7/same day/prices/"free"/commercial/guarantees, only verified claims, repipe wording copied word for word.
4. Word doc to the Drive folder "Service Pages Draft (NEW COPY)", then wait for Kim.
5. Back up (`_pl_backup_rebuild_<slug>_<date>` and `fix-backups\`).
6. Build in Elementor from template 18288 "LOCAL PAGE ANTHEM", containers only (no sections or columns), real widgets, city name swapped everywhere.
7. Apply UI/UX rules (2-column hero, 2x2 cards, answer callout box, map and video sides alternating, navy CTA, mobile rule: call buttons visible on the first 375x667 screen). Save as draft.
8. Preview at 1300/768/375, show Kim, wait for "go", publish, clear Elementor caches, purge one URL, refresh OTTO, verify desktop and Googlebot mobile.
9. Log in the change log CSV, request indexing, report.

# /restructure-local-page <city> (structure only)
Same Avondale layout, but **every word stays the same**. Backs up and fingerprints all text-like settings (`content-before.json`), converts sections to containers (the converter drops nested accordion answers, so those widgets are moved instead), then applies the layout. A design system added Oct 10-13 covers card rows, equal-width boxes, video width, section rhythm, type scale, readable body color #4B5563, hero buttons, "Quick Facts for <City> Homeowners" instead of "Key Takeaways", fixing invisible links in navy cards, cleaner CTA bands, non-FAQ accordions turned into open cards, unbalanced two-column rows, and the footer laptop breakpoint. Proves 0 content differences before showing Kim.

# Design spec: /rebuild-page (2026-10-07)
Approved section by section in chat. Rebuild one existing page from Kim's copy doc the way Anthem was rebuilt Oct 7: fix house-rule problems and list every change, align one focus keyword in OTTO, build with Elementor's command API so Kim can watch, responsive pass at three widths, save as draft, publish only on "go". Out of scope: new pages, sweeps, homepage, sign/offer and held pages, header/footer, phones. Open spike: prove that Save Draft on a published page leaves the live page unchanged.

# Keyword research and cannibalization skill
`pipeliners-keyword-research`: research only for one pasted pipelinersusa.com URL, producing a ChatGPT-ready brief. Steps: confirm page identity and the page inventory, GSC baseline (28 and 90 days, branded vs non-branded, position buckets), Search Atlas research (label unavailable data, never fake volumes), cannibalization matrix with Low/Medium/High/Unknown risk and actions (TARGET, SUPPORT, RESERVE, AVOID, RESEARCH FURTHER), then one primary and 5-8 secondary keywords. Deliverable sections A to I, ending with a copy-paste handoff. Never drafts copy or touches WordPress.
